title: Nasruddin and the River
summary: Nasruddin sat on the riverbank for hours, watching the water rush past....
full_text:
Nasruddin sat on the riverbank for hours, watching the water rush past.

"What are you waiting for, Mulla?" asked a traveler.

"I am waiting for this river to finish flowing past so I can cross to the other side with dry slippers!"
moral: Waiting for obstacles to disappear on their own is the philosophy of fools.
